sentences.Marit og Ingrid er på salg i klesbutikke: Marit and Ingrid are at the sale in the clothes shop.
sentences.Kan jeg hjelpe dere med noe?: Can I help you with anything?
I want to buy a nice shirt for Håvard. He needs new clothes, but he doesn't like going to shops.
sentences.Der borte i herreavdelingen er det noen: Over there in the men's department there are some nice men's shirts.
sentences.Ja, så fine, og de er på salg også. Unns: Yes, very nice, and they're on sale too. Excuse me, can you help me? I'd like to look at shirts for a man.
sentences.Ja, selvsagt. Hvilken størrelse bruker h: Yes, of course. What size does he wear?
sentences.Han bruker large. Har dere disse skjorte: He wears large. Do you have these shirts in large?
sentences.Nei, dessverre. De er utsolgt, men hva m: No, I'm afraid not. They're sold out, but what about this light blue shirt?
sentences.Den er litt dyr, men Håvard liker fargen: It's a bit expensive, but Håvard likes the colour. I'll take it!
sentences.Skal jeg pakke den inn?: Shall I wrap it for you?
sentences.I dameavdelingen er det noen skjørt på s: In the women's department there are some skirts on sale. Look how nice they are!
sentences.Ja, de er kjempefine. Jeg har lyst på en: Yes, they're really nice. I'd like a new dress or a new skirt for the birthday party tomorrow.
sentences.Jeg gleder meg veldig til bursdagsmiddag: I'm really looking forward to the birthday dinner at your place. Who's coming?
sentences.Det kommer noen gode venner, og Bjørnar: Some good friends are coming, and Bjørnar is coming too. Do you remember him? Håvard's friend, you know. We met him on the beach this summer.
Oh yes. I remember him. He's nice.
I'd like to try on this dress.
It's over there on the left.
sentences.Har du en i medium?: Do you have one in medium?
I bought a short black dress.
sentences.Ja, jeg kjøpte et brunt skjørt, et gult: Yes, I bought a brown skirt, a yellow scarf and two white tops. Don't we look nice! Now we're ready to party!
sentences.I går var jeg på handletur sammen med Vi: Yesterday I went shopping with Viola.
We went to lots of clothes shops.
sentences.Jeg kjøpte en genser, et rødt sjal og et: I bought a jumper, a red shawl and a pair of brown shoes.
sentences.Klærne var ikke så dyre, for det var sal: The clothes weren't very expensive, because there was a sale in the shop.
I like buying clothes on sale.
sentences.Så fine klær, og så pen du er, Hawa!: What nice clothes, and how pretty you are, Hawa!
sentences.Hun har på seg ei svart treningsbukse, e: She is wearing black tracksuit bottoms, a yellow top and white trainers.
sentences.Han har på seg en grå shorts, ei rød T-s: He is wearing grey shorts, a red T-shirt and brown sandals.
sentences.Gutten har på seg ei lyseblå truse og ei: The boy is wearing light blue underpants and a white vest.
sentences.Om vinteren trenger han også varmt ullun: In winter he also needs warm wool underwear.
sentences.Hun har på seg ei blå bukse, en grønn to: She is wearing blue trousers, a green top and a black jacket.
sentences.Han har på seg ei brun bukse, en stripet: He is wearing brown trousers, a striped jumper and white socks.
sentences.Hun har på seg ei fin kåpe og fine støvl: She is wearing a nice coat and nice ankle boots.
sentences.Han har på seg regntøy og grønne gummist: He is wearing rain gear and green wellies.
sentences.Gutten har på seg en varm parkdress, ei: The boy is wearing a warm snowsuit, a striped hat, a yellow scarf and red mittens.
sentences.Hun har på seg en hvit kjole, et rødt sj: She is wearing a white dress, a red shawl and white dress shoes.
sentences.Hun har ei brun veske, et fint kjede og: She has a brown handbag, a nice necklace and a nice ring.
sentences.Han har på seg en svart dress, ei hvit s: He is wearing a black suit, a white shirt, a checked tie and black dress shoes.
sentences.Jenta har på seg et rødt skjørt, en gul: The girl is wearing a red skirt, a yellow blouse and yellow dress shoes.
